scenarios.name: campus_bag_dialogue_enhanced_v1
scenarios.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: Reference identity contract — <Picture 1> is the same dark-blue school backpack in every shot; preserve its fabric, zipper, shoulder straps, back padding, color and proportions. <Picture 2> is the same young girl (S2) in every shot; preserve her face, hairstyle, age and clothing. <Picture 3> is the same young man (S1) in every shot; preserve his face, hairstyle, age and clothing. <Audio 1> is the sole voice reference for (S2). <Audio 2> is the sole voice reference for (S1). Do not swap, blend or invent their voices.

[Shot 1]
One continuous cinematic take at a quiet school entrance in soft morning sunlight. Start with an extreme close-up of <Picture 1>; show the dark-blue fabric weave, zipper teeth, shoulder straps and back padding with the exact reference design. The camera slowly and smoothly pulls backward, revealing (S2), matching <Picture 2>, already wearing the backpack. Trees and the teaching building remain stable in the background. No person speaks; both mouths remain closed. The zipper makes a brief metallic sound and the fabric softly rubs as (S2) adjusts one strap. No cut, no narration, no subtitles.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.20,
Continue the same take without a cut. (S1), matching <Picture 3>, walks naturally along the campus path toward (S2); synchronized footsteps approach. He smiles, stops beside her and gently pats her shoulder, producing a soft clothing-contact sound. Facing (S2), with clearly visible synchronized lip movement and the voice identity of <Audio 2>, (S1) speaks in a calm, caring tone: <d>[Chinese] 准备好了吗？今天上学别忘带东西。</d> (S2) listens silently with her lips completely closed. Preserve the backpack and both identities exactly.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.20,
Continue the same take without a cut. Facing (S1), with clearly visible synchronized lip movement and the voice identity of <Audio 1>, (S2) answers naturally and confidently: <d>[Chinese] 都带好了，我自己可以背。</d> (S1) listens silently with his lips completely closed. He then adjusts one shoulder strap of <Picture 1>; the strap and fabric make a soft rubbing sound. They turn and walk side by side toward the teaching building as the camera smoothly eases backward into a medium-wide view. Natural synchronized footsteps and quiet morning campus ambience continue. Do not add any other speech, voiceover, singing, subtitles or cuts.

overall_soundscape: Quiet morning campus ambience, light breeze through leaves, synchronized footsteps, one soft shoulder pat, backpack zipper and fabric/strap friction. Dialogue is clean, dry and foregrounded; use <Audio 2> only for (S1) and <Audio 1> only for (S2). No narration, no extra voices, no singing.
